blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cirtek Holdings Philippines Corp. plans to sell its wholly owned electronics subsidiary to an Indian company for $20.2 million, freeing up funds to reduce debt and support its remaining core business. In a disclosure on Monday, the listed company said its board approved the sale of Cirtek Electronics Corp. (CEC) to Sancode Semi Private Ltd., subject to standard closing conditions. READ: Cirtek lists debt paper for working capital funding The transaction covers 155,511,959 common shares, representing CEC’s entire issued and outstanding capital stock.
